name: Echo DMD sigmas + conditioning remap
plain: Sigmas at preset points for a DMD-trained model, plus a node that rewrites a sigma list. Nearest snaps each value to the closest trained anchor. Interpolated returns the value unchanged inside the anchor range, because its lerp cancels out. The sampler uses one sigma for both model and step, so step size and conditioning are not decoupled, despite the docstring.
math: Remap node on the whole list: none σ′=σ; nearest σ′=closest of DMD_ANCHORS (hard-coded); interpolate t=(σ−s_lo)/(s_hi−s_lo), σ′=s_lo+t(s_hi−s_lo)=σ. Sampler: model and Euler step both use the list's σ.
label: from code

audit.note: echo_dmd_sampler.py:143-144: t=(σ−s_lo)/(s_hi−s_lo), then s_lo+t(s_hi−s_lo), which cancels to σ, so 'interpolate' returns σ unchanged inside the anchor range. remap_sigma is called only at :426, in a node that rewrites a SIGMAS list. The sampler at :295 and :309 uses the same σ for the model and the step, so nothing is decoupled despite the docstring at :110.
